title: LMG SPIN UP
why: His order: "add lmg spin up". The Support MG now winds up. Hold the trigger and nothing fires for the first fifth of a second or so while the barrels turn; then the shots come slowly and speed up until, three quarters of a second in, it fires at its own full rate. Let go and it winds down over about half a second, so a short pause keeps most of the speed and a long one starts it over. A rising whirr plays while it winds and is cut when you let go. Only the Support MG does this; every other gun fires exactly as before.
now: The Support MG spins up: a short wind, slow first shots, then its full rate.
